findings.armEffect: none: all 12 runs valid; per workload all runs chose the same lever, and arm means differ by less than the within-arm spread
findings.joinHypothesis: not supported: O vs P+ is 1.220 vs 1.231 (TypeORM) and 1.151 vs 1.190 (pdf-lib)
findings.quantityDecidesLever: did not discriminate: every arm, P included, chose the getParameters copy on TypeORM
findings.pdflibSpread: explained by the variant, not the machine: baseline medians are 4143-4174 ms in all six runs; runs that still read the CharCodes enum per byte reached about 1.05x, runs that hoisted it about 1.25x, r12 with partial hoisting 1.135x. Under tsx, CharCodes members are esbuild export getters, the loader artifact the protocol named as a trap, so much of the 1.05-1.25 gap is specific to the tsx-run workload and would likely shrink in a compiled build (not measured)
findings.feedbackLoop: agents could time their candidates with the measure script (no profilers); r04 and r08 measured their small gain and attributed it to noise under machine load (r08 reports load averages up to 41); r07 measured skip-only at about 4% and then hoisted the constants
findings.semantics: 4 of 6 TypeORM runs (both O, both P+) made the public getParameters() return the live map; both P runs kept the public copy and changed only the internal execute path. Not graded; the blind grading was not run
